title: Pasilla RNA-seq gene-count demonstration data
kind: observational study counts and sample metadata
study_ids: Brooks et al. 2010/2011 Pasilla knock-down experiment

provenance.observations: RNA-seq experiment in Drosophila melanogaster cell cultures; Pasilla siRNA/RNAi knockdown versus untreated controls. External Pasilla package source reports 3 knockdown and 4 untreated biological replicates and GEO accession GSE18508.
provenance.source_identity: Pasilla data package; DESeq2 states the gene-count and annotation files were copied from pasilla into DESeq2 inst/extdata.
provenance.adaptations: DESeq2 vignette strips the 'fb' suffix from annotation sample names and reorders count columns. It factors condition and sequencing type. Sequencing type is single-read or paired-end metadata, not treatment.
provenance.grouping_evidence: DESeq2 vignette lines 411-435 explicitly says its two extdata assets are copied from the Pasilla package; lines 642-650 identifies the same Pasilla experiment. The current upstream package preprocessing vignette reports GSE18508 and replicate structure (version 1.40.0). The precise processing algorithm for the copied per-gene matrix was not inspected.

biological_context.assay: RNA sequencing; library sequencing includes single-read and paired-end sample types per DESeq2 annotation
biological_context.design: Pasilla RNAi/siRNA knockdown versus untreated control; source package reports 3 versus 4 biological replicates
biological_context.experimental_units: 7 biological replicates, source-reported by Pasilla package vignette
biological_context.metadata: condition, type, number of lanes, total number of reads, exon counts; values and sample labels shown in annotation CSV

assets.stage: gene-level read-count matrix; count-generation provenance not resolved from inspected lines
assets.relationships: Copied from Pasilla package according to the DESeq2 vignette; paired with the following annotation asset.
Seven rows; links sample file IDs to condition and sequencing type plus read/lane summary metadata. Vignette normalizes sample IDs and reorders count matrix columns against this table.

assets.version: Pasilla package 1.40.0 as rendered on official Bioconductor, retrieved 2026-09-30; unpinned mutable release URL
assets.format: RNA-seq source data and derived exon/gene count package assets described in vignette
assets.stage: source FASTQ/SRA study through alignment and count products; this source specifically details exon count construction, not the DESeq2 copied gene matrix derivation
assets.relationships: The package vignette reports FASTQ from GEO, TopHat alignment, Ensembl release 62 BDGP5.25.62 genome/GTF references, DEXSeq exon preparation/counting for exon assets, and 3 knockdown/4 control biological replicates. Do not assume those exon-stage files are identical to the gene matrix or DESeq2 HTSeq demo files without file-level verification.

access_and_terms.access: GEO source accession and package extdata are publicly described; actual downloads were not performed.
access_and_terms.reuse_evidence: Current Pasilla vignette labels the software/data package License LGPL, but reuse terms for GEO reads and each packaged data asset were not independently established. The DESeq2 code repository declares LGPL (>=3), which is not by itself proof of underlying-data terms.

inspection.read: DESeq2 pinned tree entries and small annotation CSV; vignette input/loading and biological context; official Pasilla package preprocessing vignette lines 23-48 and 66-96.
inspection.previewed: Full 7-row annotation CSV; no count matrix rows or GEO biological files.
inspection.not_verified: Count matrix dimensions/values; gene ID universe; gene-matrix count pipeline; exact current Pasilla data package asset identity; checksums and data-use terms.

limitations: Counts and genomic files were not downloaded; the tree-reported compressed count asset size is not a record of its uncompressed contents.
External Pasilla vignette is a mutable release rendering retrieved 2026-09-30 and reports package 1.40.0; no immutable source commit was captured.
External processing details establish exon-count provenance but do not establish the exact origin/processing of DESeq2's copied gene-level matrix.
Public access does not establish unrestricted reuse rights.

title: GEUVADIS transcript-quantifier outputs packaged by tximportData
study_ids: GEUVADIS; individual sample/run accessions not inspected

provenance.observations: tximportData package description says its quantifier output was generated on six GEUVADIS RNA-seq samples.
provenance.source_identity: Bioconductor tximportData data package, manual version 1.38.0, repository 3.22, commit 5c04cae (dated 2025-10-29) as reported in official manual retrieved 2026-09-30.
provenance.adaptations: DESeq2 vignette uses Salmon quant.sf.gz outputs and tx2gene.gencode.v27.csv, but creates artificial sample condition labels A and B for demonstration. Do not treat A/B as observed exposure labels.
provenance.grouping_evidence: Package manual attributes quantifier outputs to the same six GEUVADIS RNA-seq samples; the DESeq2 vignette describes its extdata files as tximportData package demonstration assets.

biological_context.assay: RNA-seq; Salmon transcript abundance quantifications used in the vignette
biological_context.design: Actual sample variables shown include pop and center; displayed condition factor A/B is fabricated for the tutorial
biological_context.experimental_units: 6 samples, source-reported by package manual; exact run IDs not inspected
biological_context.metadata: sample table columns run, pop, center; mapping filename indicates GENCODE v27 transcript-to-gene map

assets.format: R data package containing multiple quantifier outputs
assets.relationships: Package manual says six GEUVADIS samples and Cufflinks, RSEM, kallisto, Salmon, Sailfish and alevin example outputs.

assets.format: tximportData extdata paths: sample table, Salmon quant.sf.gz files and tx2gene.gencode.v27.csv
assets.stage: transcript-level estimated abundances and mapping, transformed by tximport to gene-level estimated counts
assets.relationships: The vignette describes this as demonstration-only package content and assigns artificial condition labels; no individual files were fetched.

access_and_terms.access: Package is distributed by Bioconductor; no files downloaded.
access_and_terms.reuse_evidence: Inspected package manual reports GPL (>=2) for tximportData package. This does not independently establish terms for underlying GEUVADIS observations or individual quantification assets.

inspection.read: DESeq2 vignette lines 256-359 and tximportData package manual page 1 lines 0-23.
inspection.previewed: Metadata/manual text only; no Salmon quant files, sample table, or mapping rows.
inspection.not_verified: Individual runs, biological metadata, Salmon/version provenance, quantification values, exact package extdata checksums, and source-study reuse terms.

limitations: Sample-level identities and assay context beyond RNA-seq/GEUVADIS are unknown from inspected sources.
Mutable Bioconductor package release rendering may not be identical to the package version assumed by the DESeq2 source vignette.
The artificial A/B condition prevents interpreting the import example as a biological contrast.

title: Airway smooth muscle RNA-seq gene counts

provenance.observations: RNA-seq of four human airway smooth-muscle cell lines under control and dexamethasone treatment; package documentation reports phenotypic data from GEO and FASTQ from SRA.
provenance.source_identity: Bioconductor airway data package; manual version 1.32.0, repository 3.23, commit deb0a4f dated 2026-04-28, retrieved 2026-09-30.
provenance.adaptations: DESeq2 vignette loads packaged airway RangedSummarizedExperiment and constructs design ~ cell + dex; no change to observations is described.
provenance.grouping_evidence: The DESeq2 example explicitly loads data(airway) from the airway package; the manual identifies the packaged object as gene read counts and its study/accession.

biological_context.material: airway smooth muscle cell lines; four cell lines
biological_context.design: Two conditions: control and dexamethasone treatment; vignette design ~ cell + dex
biological_context.experimental_units: Eight samples inferred from four cell lines under two conditions by manual wording; sample IDs/replication structure not inspected
biological_context.metadata: cell and dex are the variables used in the vignette; other metadata not inspected

assets.accession: GSE52778; SRR sample accessions not inspected
assets.stage: packaged per-gene read counts with genomic ranges and sample metadata
assets.relationships: DESeq2 vignette uses the airway object directly as constructor input. Manual separately describes a gse object with Salmon estimates in addition to airway raw/read count object; this inventory unit uses airway, not gse.

access_and_terms.access: Bioconductor package is publicly documented; no dataset download was performed.
access_and_terms.reuse_evidence: Package manual labels package License LGPL. Reuse terms for study reads and packaged observations were not separately established.

inspection.read: DESeq2 vignette lines 547-565; airway package manual pages 1-2, including dataset description, accession, format and source.
inspection.previewed: Package metadata only; no assay values or row counts.
inspection.not_verified: Exact sample annotations and count-generation method; counts/ranges; any data-level reuse terms.

limitations: The eight-sample count is a deduction from four cell lines and two conditions, not an inspected object dimension; treat exact sample count as unverified.
The package also documents a separate gse object for Salmon quantifications; it is not grouped with the airway count object because the latter's data stage and asset are distinct.
No data were downloaded or analyzed.
